question: Where along the modeled hair plate -> posterior coxa MN pathway does the right-front leg lose drive relative to LF (homolog) and LH (working leg), and how much of that is attributable to engine choices (6-synapse floor, size scaling)?
known_before_registration: Step A per-leg sensory counts and floored direct synapses per population; Step C per-leg coxa MN rates (RF 0.55 Hz, LF 22.7, LH 32.3). No per-MN weight, per-neuron output total, raw (unfloored) count, size scale or replayed conductance was computed.

sources.connectome_sets: malecns_backend.cache.load_cache (Step A sets, exactly hair_plate_identity.sensory_sets / motor_sets)
sources.engine: malecns_backend.load_malecns + MaleCNSBrain(data) with ModelConfig.calibrated(), as the live kernel constructs it

sets.sensory: Step A SNpp45 set per leg
sets.step_c_coxa: hair_plate_posture.mn_sets per-leg coxa set (actuator classes coxa, coxa_abduct, coxa_twist)
sets.replayed: union over legs of posterior, anterior and Step C coxa sets

structural.R: raw synapses from the leg's sensory set onto its posterior pool (all edges, no floor)
structural.F: same, edges with count >= min_synapses only
structural.S: sum over those edges of count * size scale of the postsynaptic MN (engine weight before sign)
structural.G: sum over those edges of engine weight * engine pre_sign
structural.identity: G = N_s * (R/N_s) * (F/R) * (S/F) * (G/S); factors SOURCE_COUNT, SYNAPSES_PER_SOURCE, FLOOR_LOSS, SIZE_SCALING, TRANSMITTER_SIGN
structural.refinement_vs_design: The design named four factors with sign folded into size scaling; sign is separated (TRANSMITTER_SIGN) so SIZE_SCALING is pure engine scaling. Fixed here before any computation.
structural.concentration: max over posterior MNs of W_m divided by G (reported, not in the identity)
structural.W_m: sum over sensory s of engine weight(s->m) * pre_sign(s) * psp_scale
structural.mean_field_g_m: W_m * r * dt/1000 / (1 - exp(-dt/tau_syn)), r = hair_plate_encoder.MAX_RATE_HZ (120 Hz): discrete steady-state mean conductance of the engine's update
structural.g_star: (e_exc - v_rest) * (v_threshold - v_rest) / (e_exc - v_threshold): conductance whose steady COBA potential equals threshold
audits: Step A floored direct counts per leg and population reproduced exactly
rule weights (floor, sensory mask, size scale, inhibitory gain) and graded/OA sign equal MaleCNSBrain.weights / pre_sign on every edge into the replayed MNs

measured.raw: Step C A_ON per-tick fired lists (ticks 0..3999, time_ms = (tick+1)*0.5)
measured.M1: rate of every replayed MN in the window
measured.M2: replay from reset state: a spike recorded at tick t is delivered at the start of tick t + delay_steps; per-pre float32 delivery in recorded order with s = float32(pre_sign * psp_scale * 1); then refractory, COBA integration, threshold, reset, decay exactly as MaleCNSBrain.step. Conductances used for integration are split (float64, descriptive) into own-leg hair plates, other excitatory, inhibitory; window means reported
measured.M3: predicted vs recorded spike ticks in the window per MN. REPLAY_EXACT: all MNs identical. REPLAY_CLOSE: every MN with >= 5 recorded window spikes has >= 95% of them matched within +-1 tick, and total predicted/recorded counts within 5%. Else INCONCLUSIVE_REPLAY (Q3 withheld; Part S reported)
measured.precondition: no replayed MN is in the external schedule or any hair-plate population (MNs receive no forced events)

labels.integrity: all hashes match, all structural audits pass and M3 is REPLAY_EXACT or REPLAY_CLOSE -> INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED; a structural audit or hash failure -> INCONCLUSIVE_INTEGRITY with no labels; replay failure alone -> INCONCLUSIVE_REPLAY with Q1/Q2 given and Q3 withheld
labels.best_driven_mn: per leg, the posterior MN with the largest W_m (ties: lowest dense index)

Q1.RF_DIRECT_SUBTHRESHOLD: RF best g_m < g_star and LF or LH best g_m >= g_star
Q1.ALL_SUBTHRESHOLD: RF, LF and LH best g_m all < g_star

labels.Q2: RF vs LF: the factor with the most negative log-ratio; MIXED if the second most negative is negative and >= 0.9 x the most negative in magnitude; NO_DEFICIT if no factor is negative

Q3.INHIBITION_CONTRIBUTES: measured window-mean |g_inh| / g_exc on RF best-driven MN >= 2 x the same ratio on LF best-driven MN

labels.engine_share: (FLOOR_LOSS + SIZE_SCALING log-ratios) / log(G_RF / G_LF), reported as a number

predictions: Recorded in the design doc: Q2 SYNAPSES_PER_SOURCE then SOURCE_COUNT; Q2b concentration relevant; Q1 RF_DIRECT_SUBTHRESHOLD plausible; Q3 uncertain.
interpretation_limits: Connectome factors cannot separate real anatomy from reconstruction artifact.
Mean-field g_m ignores fluctuations and all other inputs; it is a modeled prediction.
Replay is a passive decomposition of one seed of one assisted-posture run.
Nothing here changes the engine, weights, encoder or mappings; any fix is a separate versioned intervention.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no reruns, no rule changes.
